answer: The D-HGNRs show CD peaks at **585 nm and 790 nm**. The paper says that both L- and D-HGNRs "exhibited mirror-image chiral responses with two distinct chiroptical peaks at 585 nm and 790 nm" (Fig. 1c), with g-factors of −0.0151 and 0.0150 (Fig. 1d). This is on page 3, and Figure 1c appears on page 4.
